info.name: Odoo - Phieu ho tro
info.description: Dat base_url trong Postman Environment thanh domain Odoo dang su dung (gom http:// hoac https://, khong co dau / cuoi). De goi GET tickets khong dang nhap, tai Cai dat > Ky thuat > Tham so > Thong so he thong tao mot ban ghi: Khoa = core_fastapi.api_key (ten co dinh trong code), Gia tri = chuoi bi mat ban tu dat. Vi du local: Khoa = core_fastapi.api_key, Gia tri = test1. Dien api_key bang Gia tri va chay truc tiep request 5. URL tickets la duong dan Odoo /api/v1/tickets, khong dien URL vao Gia tri. Cac request 2-4 dung session: nhap username/password va chay request 1 truoc. Endpoint /api/session/authenticate tu chon database duy nhat theo domain va cau hinh dbfilter/db_name cua server; khong can gui db. API dung route tuong doi, khong gan co dinh domain. Khong dung token auth.datgroup.com.vn.

variable.description: Domain Odoo hien tai, gom http:// hoac https:// va khong co dau / cuoi. Dat bien nay trong Environment cho tung moi truong. Postman can URL tuyet doi va khong tu suy ra domain cua website.

Gia tri bi mat cua Thong so he thong core_fastapi.api_key; vi du local: test1. Ten Khoa core_fastapi.api_key da co dinh trong code. API cap quyen doc tickets va du lieu lien quan tren toan database, khong can cau hinh User/Company cua FastAPI Endpoint. Luu Gia tri trong Environment; request 5 gui qua header X-API-Key, khong can dang nhap.

request.description: Khong can truyen db. Server phai cau hinh domain khop dung mot database qua dbfilter hoac db_name. Dang nhap thanh cong tao session_id de goi cac API tickets.

item.name: 3. Tim phieu theo ma khach hang so huu

request.description: Dien card_code bang ma khach hang so huu (res.partner.card_code), vi du C020957. Response owner_id.card_code la ma khach hang.

item.name: 4. Tim tat ca phieu theo card_code trong Body JSON

request.description: Chay dang nhap truoc. Gui GET voi Body JSON card_code, vi du C020957; khong can Params. Tra tat ca phieu duoc phep xem cua khach hang so huu co ma chinh xac, khong phan trang.

item.name: 5. Lay phieu ho tro bang API key (khong dang nhap)

request.description: Chay truc tiep khong can request dang nhap. Tai Cai dat > Ky thuat > Tham so > Thong so he thong, tao mot ban ghi: Khoa = core_fastapi.api_key, Gia tri = test1 (vi du local; production dung chuoi bi mat ngau nhien ban tu dat). Dien api_key = Gia tri, khong phai ten Khoa. URL GET la {{base_url}}/api/v1/tickets. Khoa cap quyen doc tickets va du lieu lien quan tren toan database, khong can cau hinh User/Company cua FastAPI Endpoint. API tao/sua/xoa van yeu cau dang nhap. Doi Gia tri hoac xoa ban ghi core_fastapi.api_key de thu hoi key. Khi doi database, tao cung ten Khoa core_fastapi.api_key trong database moi. Co the them query card_code de loc theo ma khach hang.
